comment: Hand-authored retrieval-quality golden set for fixtures/vault (10k notes, seed 42). Expected paths are vault-relative. Queries were written by reading each target article's prose; tags and See-also links in the fixture are randomly drawn and MUST NOT be used as relevance signals. kinds: 'semantic' = description-style, the headword never appears in the query; 'lexical' = exact/rare-term controls where keyword search should win; 'topical' = multi-note subjects, hit@5 counts any expected path.

queries.query: instrument that measures the speed and pressure of wind
queries.notes: Headword absent; article opens 'an instrument for measuring either the velocity or the pressure of the wind'.

queries.query: mineral composed of lead sulphate
queries.notes: Article: 'a mineral consisting of lead sulphate, PbSO4'.

queries.query: riddle whose answer is hidden behind metaphors
queries.notes: Article: 'a riddle or puzzle... answer is concealed by means of metaphors'.

queries.query: largest wild cat found on the American continent
queries.notes: Article: 'the largest species of the Felidae found on the American continent'.

queries.query: optical toy using inclined mirrors to create symmetrical patterns
queries.notes: Article describes symmetrical images formed by two inclined mirrors.

queries.query: Mexican garden flower named after a pupil of Linnaeus
queries.notes: Article: 'so called after Dr Dahl, a pupil of Linnaeus... indigenous in the high sandy plains of Mexico'.

queries.query: generator that turns motion into electricity
queries.notes: Paraphrases 'a machine for converting mechanical into electrical energy' without sharing its wording.

queries.query: natural hot spring that periodically erupts a column of boiling water and steam
queries.notes: Article: 'discharges into the air, at more or less regular intervals... heated water and steam'.

queries.query: the tallest living mammal, an African ruminant with a long neck
queries.notes: Article: 'the tallest of all mammals'.

queries.query: beheading machine of the French Revolution
queries.notes: Article: 'instrument for inflicting capital punishment by decapitation, introduced into France at the period of the Revolution'.

queries.query: violent tropical wind storm of the West Indies
queries.notes: Article: 'a wind-storm of great force and violence, originally as experienced in the West Indies'.

queries.query: carving material obtained from elephant tusks
queries.notes: Article: 'the material represented by the tusk of the elephant'.

queries.query: green ornamental stone comprising nephrite and jadeite
queries.notes: Article names both nephrite and jadeite as the two species.

queries.query: primates of Madagascar that are neither monkeys nor apes
queries.notes: Article: 'peculiar Malagasy representatives of the order PRIMATES... neither monkeys nor apes'.

queries.query: cylinder of wax around a wick burnt to give light
queries.notes: Article: 'a cylindrical rod of solid fatty or waxy matter, enclosing a central fibrous wick... burnt for giving light'.

queries.query: the most important vegetable fibre, hairs attached to plant seeds
queries.notes: Article: 'the most important of the vegetable fibres... hairs which occur attached to the seeds'.

queries.query: bird of prey once the most familiar in Great Britain, now among its rarest
queries.notes: The EB1911 Kite article is the bird (Milvus), not the toy — a deliberate sense test.

queries.query: dietary substance from tree seeds that is the basis of chocolate
queries.notes: Avoids 'Theobroma', which would hand lexical search a rare-term win.

queries.query: nebulous celestial body travelling a highly eccentric orbit around the sun
queries.notes: Article: 'seemingly nebulous bodies... in very eccentric orbits'.

queries.query: limestone skeletons built by marine polyps into reefs
queries.notes: Article: 'hard skeletons of various marine organisms... deposited in the tissues of Anthozoan polyps'.

queries.query: prearranged single combat fought under conventional rules of honour
queries.notes: Article: 'a prearranged encounter between two persons, with deadly weapons, in accordance with conventional rules'.

queries.query: suspended particles near the ground that make surrounding objects invisible
queries.notes: Article: 'distribution of solid or liquid particles in the surface layers of the atmosphere'.

queries.query: domesticated South American pack animal of the camel family
queries.notes: Article: 'the larger of the two domesticated members of the camel-tribe indigenous to South America'.

queries.query: eighteenth century British statesman and orator, son of Lord Holland
queries.notes: The EB1911 Fox article is Charles James Fox, not the animal — a sense test the title alone cannot answer.

queries.query: Victorian naturalist who developed the theory of evolution by natural selection
queries.notes: Avoids 'origin of species', which appears verbatim in the article.

queries.query: English scientist famous for discoveries in electromagnetism and electrochemistry
queries.notes: Article: 'English chemist and physicist'.

queries.query: German philosopher who examined the limits of pure reason
queries.notes: Description-style; headword absent.

queries.query: island nation of east Asia that rose to great power status
queries.notes: Targets the vault's largest note (832 KB) — exercises the chunking path.

queries.query: Florentine political theorist whose name became a byword for cunning statecraft
queries.notes: Article: 'Italian statesman and writer... born at Florence'.

queries.query: Scottish missionary who explored Africa
queries.notes: Article: 'Scottish missionary and explorer in Africa'.

queries.query: phlogiston
queries.notes: Rare term (9 notes contain it, verified by grep); these three treat the theory centrally. Mirrors default.json's rare tier.

queries.query: Chateaubriant
queries.notes: Exact title match; the title boost should make this trivial for lexical search.

queries.query: Asolo
queries.notes: Exact title match, rare term.

queries.query: Handel
queries.notes: Exact title match.

queries.query: Cromwell
queries.notes: Exact title match.

queries.query: Dante
queries.notes: Exact title match.

queries.query: emerald beryl
queries.notes: Two-term query; both words in the article's opening sentence.

queries.query: hydrodynamics
queries.notes: Exact title match, technical term.

queries.query: argon
queries.notes: Exact title match, rare term.

queries.query: Lavoisier
queries.notes: Exact title match.

queries.query: birds of prey
queries.notes: Any raptor article counts; hit@5 = any expected path.

queries.query: large wild cats
queries.notes: All three are Felidae articles.

queries.query: green gemstones
queries.notes: Both articles open on green ornamental stones.

queries.query: fermented alcoholic beverages
queries.notes: Beer (barley) and cider (apples) both open as fermented drinks.

queries.query: medieval hand weapons
queries.notes: Both open as hand weapons; Mace's EB1911 primary sense is the weapon, not the spice.

queries.query: violent weather phenomena
queries.notes: Meteorological articles.

queries.query: textile fibres and fabrics
queries.notes: Fibre and fabric articles.

queries.query: musical instruments
queries.notes: Wind and percussion.

queries.query: great German composers
queries.notes: Both articles open 'German musical composer' (Handel: 'German by origin').

queries.query: foods made from milk
queries.notes: Both open as milk-derived foods.
